name: Base Game Family House
author: SimsWithNora
style: Mid-century raised ranch on a city park lot: a tuck-under garage between fieldstone piers under a balcony room with a dark slat rail, the main floor a storey up behind a brick-walled loggia, pale ashlar over a dark brick base under a tall west shed and a low asymmetric east gable, a switchback picket-railed stoop through brick planters, stepping stones across a lavender cottage garden
